ideas.hypothesis: When IPO prices are capped by regulation, the market reaches a pooling outcome. In that regime, information-asymmetry proxies (firm age, VC backing, analyst or underwriter reputation) should explain less of the variation in first-day returns and long-run performance than they do under market-based pricing, where a separating outcome lets prices sort issuers. Firms that went public under the cap should also be more likely to use separating securities (callable or mandatory convertibles) in their follow-on financing.

sources.role: mechanism: regulated IPO pricing yields a pooling equilibrium, and marketized pricing yields a separating equilibrium
mechanism: callable or mandatory convertibles can remove the adverse-selection cost when the market receives noisy information over time

ideas.test: An event study of Chinese A-share IPOs from 2005 to 2019 (CSMAR), using the regime switches in the P/E cap (cap removed in 2009, reinstated in practice around 2014) as variation in pricing regime. Regress first-day returns and 3-year buy-and-hold abnormal returns on asymmetry proxies, interacted with a cap-binding dummy. As a second step, run a logit for convertible-bond issuance within 5 years of the IPO, by regime.
ideas.disconfirming: Asymmetry proxies predict underpricing and long-run returns equally strongly under both regimes, or firms that listed under the cap are no more likely to issue convertibles later.

ideas.hypothesis: When the stock-level information asymmetry is high and OTM options are relatively liquid, informed traders should move from a pooling equilibrium (trading in both venues) toward a separating one concentrated in OTM options. If so, the lead of signed OTM option order flow over stock returns should increase with asymmetry, while the stock-to-option feedback should weaken.

sources.role: finding and method: two-way feedback between OTM option trades and equities, consistent with pooling, and dependent on moneyness, asymmetry and liquidity
mechanism: conditions under which security design supports a separating rather than a pooling outcome
mechanism: framing of pooling versus separating equilibria under information asymmetry
setting: faster digital information flows that change where information is impounded

ideas.test: Intraday stock trades and quotes (TAQ) and option trades (OPRA or OptionMetrics) for about 200 stocks over one year. Sort stock-days by an asymmetry proxy (PIN or the adverse-selection component of the spread) and by relative option liquidity. Estimate bivariate VARs or Granger tests of signed OTM option volume against 5-minute stock returns, and compare the lead coefficients across sorts.
ideas.disconfirming: The option-to-stock lead and the stock-to-option feedback do not change with asymmetry or option liquidity, or the option lead is weaker in high-asymmetry stocks.

ideas.hypothesis: As the hard information environment improves (credit-registry coverage, accounting-standard enforcement), the value of soft information in SME lending should fall. The negative effect of relationship length on collateral requirements and loan rates should therefore be weaker where hard information is richer.

sources.role: mechanism: framework placing the information environment within the lending infrastructure that shapes SME lending technologies
mechanism and measure: soft information carried through interpersonal relationships, with relationship length, breadth and depth as measures

ideas.test: Firm-level World Bank Enterprise Survey data for SMEs in several countries or Chinese provinces. Merge in credit-registry or bureau coverage at country or province level. Regress collateral required (% of loan) and loan rejection on the length of the main-bank relationship, interacted with registry coverage, controlling for firm size, age and sector.
ideas.disconfirming: The interaction between relationship length and registry coverage is zero or positive, meaning soft information matters as much or more when hard information is abundant.

ideas.hypothesis: How a market reacts to news should depend on the quality of the news. Low-precision signals (early-match events whose outcome implications are noisy) should produce overreaction followed by reversal, and high-precision signals (late-match events) should produce underreaction followed by drift. The sign of the post-event drift should switch as signal precision rises.

sources.role: finding and method: overreaction in the first innings and underreaction in the second in Betfair in-play cricket, using Monte Carlo win probabilities
mechanism: low-quality information induces overreaction among information users
measure: the information source, content and quality dimensions that shape how agents respond

ideas.test: Betfair in-play odds for about 150 one-day cricket matches. Simulate model-implied win probabilities by Monte Carlo. For each wicket or boundary event, compute signal precision as the reduction in the outcome variance implied by the model. Regress the post-event price drift over the next 5 to 30 minutes on the size of the initial price jump, interacted with precision.
ideas.disconfirming: Post-event drift has the same sign at every level of precision, or more precise signals are followed by reversals rather than continuation.

ideas.hypothesis: When a research joint venture forms with extensive information sharing, more knowledge leaks to outsiders, so rival non-member firms should earn positive (contagion-type) abnormal returns. When the RJV shares little, rivals should earn negative (competition-type) abnormal returns. The effect should be larger for rivals that are more similar to the members.

sources.role: mechanism: voluntary information sharing in RJVs increases leakage to outsiders, and firms tend to choose all or nothing
method: intra-industry event study separating competitive and contagion effects, with similarity to the announcing firm as a moderator

ideas.test: An event study of about 100 RJV announcements (US National Cooperative Research Act filings in the Federal Register, or EU-registered joint ventures). Code the information-sharing scope from the filing text (full technology or data exchange versus a narrow cost-sharing project). Compute 3-day CARs for same-industry non-member rivals and regress them on sharing scope, rival similarity and concentration.
ideas.disconfirming: Rival CARs are unrelated to sharing scope, or are more negative when sharing is extensive.

ideas.hypothesis: Drivers should divert more after a VMS incident message when another source they consult (radio or in-vehicle navigation) corroborates it, and divert less when the sources conflict. A message that names a specific location should matter more when no other source is available.

sources.role: finding and setting: VMS diversion depends on the specific location named and on available alternatives, from European field trials
method: verbal-protocol evidence on which pre-trip and en-route sources drivers consult when deciding on diversion
method: a fuzzy model of online route choice under information provision, usable to estimate diversion responses

ideas.test: A stated-preference driving-simulator experiment with about 120 drivers in a 2x2x2 design: VMS message (specific versus generic location), second source (absent, corroborating, conflicting), and incident severity. Record whether drivers divert. Validate against loop-detector diversion counts on one corridor where VMS logs and radio traffic bulletins can be matched by time.
ideas.disconfirming: Diversion rates are the same whether the second source corroborates or conflicts with the VMS message.

ideas.hypothesis: Stronger internal control should raise the decision value of local-government financial reports, measured objectively by an unqualified audit opinion and a shorter reporting lag rather than by self-reported perceptions. The effect should be larger where staff quality and use of financial information systems are higher.

sources.role: finding: internal control and implementation of the regional financial accounting system (SAKD) are associated with financial statement quality
measure: information value operationalized as reliability and timeliness
mechanism: human resource quality and work motivation as moderators of the effect of internal control on reporting quality

ideas.test: A panel of about 500 Indonesian local governments from 2010 to 2019, built from Indonesia's Supreme Audit Board (BPK) audit summaries: the audit opinion, the count of internal-control findings, and report submission dates. Run ordered logits of audit opinion and regressions of reporting lag on internal-control findings, interacted with staff education and an indicator for adopting a financial information system.
ideas.disconfirming: Counts of internal-control weaknesses do not predict audit opinions or reporting lags once the measures are objective rather than survey-based.

ideas.hypothesis: Internet-based pre-trip multimodal services and in-vehicle en-route information should be complements rather than substitutes: users of one should be more likely to use the other. Joint users should switch route or mode more often than users of either source alone.

sources.role: setting: ATIS systems that combine pre-trip, en-route and in-vehicle information
setting: an internet-based pre-trip travel information service
setting: an online door-to-door multimodal information system
measure: commuters' ratings of an incumbent en-route source (commercial radio) for comparison

ideas.test: An online survey of about 600 commuters recording weekly use of online journey planners, in-vehicle navigation or traffic apps, and radio, plus self-reported route or mode switches in the past month. Estimate a bivariate probit for use of the two sources with demographic and trip controls, and a count model of switching by usage combination.
ideas.disconfirming: Use of the two sources is negatively correlated after controls, or joint users do not switch more than single-source users.

ideas.hypothesis: On Northern European cross-border corridors, where pre-trip information is lagged and fragmented across national systems, en-route or in-vehicle information should reduce expected travel time and travel-time variance more than pre-trip-only information. That gain should be larger than on comparable domestic routes.

sources.role: method: an optimal adaptive routing algorithm with partial online information (time-lagged, pre-trip only, or link-subset)
setting: a cross-border pre-trip information service covering five Northern European countries
mechanism: the distinction between pre-trip, en-route and in-vehicle information provision

ideas.test: Calibrate a stochastic time-dependent network for one cross-border corridor (for example Hamburg to Copenhagen) and one domestic corridor of similar length, using historical link travel-time data. Compute optimal adaptive routing under the three information variants and compare expected travel times and their standard deviations.
ideas.disconfirming: In-vehicle information yields no greater improvement over pre-trip-only information on the cross-border corridor than on the domestic corridor.

ideas.hypothesis: Around new transit-oriented development stations, residents who report higher information overload about new mobility services and neighborhood changes (such as app-based sharing and redevelopment notices) should use the new transit less and report greater intention to move. This would be one channel through which TOD-driven neighborhood change marginalizes incumbent residents.

sources.role: mechanism: information overload and segregation in data-rich future cities with shared mobility
setting and finding: TOD at St. Louis's Delmar Loop risks further marginalizing high-need residents

ideas.test: A door-to-door or mail survey of about 300 residents within 1 km of Delmar Loop light-rail stations and about 300 residents of a comparison neighborhood. Collect a short information-overload scale, transit and shared-mobility use, tenure, income and intention to move. Regress use and moving intention on overload, interacted with TOD exposure.
ideas.disconfirming: Information overload is unrelated to transit use or moving intention, or the association is no stronger near the TOD stations.
